title: value and comment on the same line in config
body:
Originally reported by: **Dmitry Andreychuk (BitBucket: [and_dmitry](http://bitbucket.org/and_dmitry))**

---

Pylint crashes when config file has value and comment on the same line, e.g.:

```
persistent=yes # yeah
```

version:

```
pylint 1.1.0, 
astroid 1.0.1, common 0.61.0
Python 3.3.2+ (default, Oct  9 2013, 14:50:09) 
[GCC 4.8.1]
```

traceback:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/pylint", line 9, in <module>
    load_entry_point('pylint==1.1.0', 'console_scripts', 'pylint')()
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.3/dist-packages/pylint/__init__.py", line 21, in run_pylint
    Run(sys.argv[1:])
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.3/dist-packages/pylint/lint.py", line 1012, in __init__
    linter.load_config_file()
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.3/dist-packages/logilab/common/configuration.py", line 663, in load_config_file
    provider.set_option(option, value, optdict=optdict)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.3/dist-packages/pylint/lint.py", line 402, in set_option
    BaseTokenChecker.set_option(self, optname, value, action, optdict)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.3/dist-packages/logilab/common/configuration.py", line 813, in set_option
    value = _validate(value, optdict, opt)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.3/dist-packages/logilab/common/configuration.py", line 309, in _validate
    return _call_validator(_type, optdict, name, value)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.3/dist-packages/logilab/common/configuration.py", line 225, in _call_validator
    return VALIDATORS[opttype](optdict, option, value)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.3/dist-packages/logilab/common/configuration.py", line 170, in yn_validator
    return optik_ext.check_yn(None, name, value)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.3/dist-packages/logilab/common/optik_ext.py", line 105, in check_yn
    raise OptionValueError(msg % (opt, value))
optparse.OptionValueError: option persistent: invalid yn value 'yes # yeah', should be in (y, yes, n, no)
```

I'm creating issue because this syntax is described as legit in [documentation](http://docs.pylint.org/faq.html#what-is-the-format-of-the-configuration-file)
